data.name: You're here again
data.detailed_description:
In this surreal, weirdcore fast-paced movement shooter, awaken in a distorted afterlife and master a wide range of mobility mechanics, including wall running, sliding, and grappling, to propel yourself through the strange architecture and enemies you will encounter. Learn new ways to combo these together with your ever-growing arsenal of weapons in order to tear through the creatures that haunt this strange new realm.

Every level pulls you deeper into an ever-stranger afterlife where you feel your identity slowly coming apart. The spaces feel familiar but wrong, small elements reminding you of the man you were before, all distorted and unfinished as if it was all just a dream. Your only way forward is speed, precision, and learning how to bend the game’s systems until they break.

Compete for leaderboard dominance across meticulously crafted levels, balancing speed against score as you route perfect runs. Defeat bosses to unlock new layers of the world… then do it all again, but cleaner, faster, and with a higher rank. How fast can you reach the end and find yourself here again?

MOVEMENT AS A CORE WEAPON

FLUID MOVEMENT IS YOUR GREATEST WEAPON
Master a full kit designed for speed and creative expression:

  • Wall Run: Scale surreal surfaces and impossible angles.

  • Slide: Dodge attacks, squeeze through gaps, and maintain your momentum.

  • Grapple: Fling yourself across the levels with your stretchy arm and chain paths no one else sees.

  • Slam: Drop down, gaining momentum to transfer into insane slides or jumps to fly across gaps.

  • Conserve Momentum: String jumps, portals, and bouncy mushrooms together to stay in constant flow.

COMBAT THAT FEEDS YOUR SPEED

SPEED IS YOUR AMMO. MOVEMENT IS YOUR STRATEGY
Our combat system is built to interact with how you move:

  • Velocity-Based Damage: Go faster to hit harder. Your speed charges a critical bar, turning every hit you do into a critical strike.

  • Strategic Arsenal: Unlock a variety of weapons, each with unique roles, synergies, and links to movement.

  • Weapon Movement Exclusives: Propel yourself with explosions, grapple your own projectiles, or utilise recoil to boost your speed even more.

  • Adapt or Fail: Fight over 10 different enemy types and variants that force you to adapt your routes and force split-second decisions.

  • Epic Boss Confrontations: Test your skills against 3 major bosses that guard new layers of the afterlife and test everything you’ve learned.

BUILT FOR SPEEDRUNS AND REPLAY VALUE

DESIGNED TO BE MASTERED, THEN BROKEN
This isn’t a game you play once—it’s a game you master for hundreds of hours:

  • 33 Carefully Crafted Levels: Each designed around movement first, full of discovery, filled with shortcuts and advanced tech.

  • Deep Ranking System: Achieve P-Ranks by playing aggressive, smart routing, and execution under pressure.

  • Global Leaderboards: Compete against friends, rivals, and the wider global community for ultimate bragging rights.

  • Emergent Gameplay: We encourage you to break the game. Find unintended solutions to levels and redefine what’s possible.

ACCESSIBLE YET DEEP

EASY TO LEARN, A LIFETIME TO MASTER
You’re Here Again is designed to be easy to pick up, hard to truly master:

  • Low Skill Floor: Jump in, run, shoot, grapple, feel the thrill of movement in minutes.

  • High Skill Ceiling: Thousands of hours of optimisation potential for movement tech, routing, and score grinding.

  • Play Your Way: Built to support both casual play sessions and serious competitive or speedrun-focused grinding.

FOR FANS OF MOVEMENT, SPEED, AND STRANGE SPACES

IF YOU LOVE:

  • The fluid, expressive traversal of levels.

  • The relentless pursuit of perfection in speedrunning, breaking records, score chasing, route optimisation.

  • The surreal, nostalgic unease of weirdcore and liminal space aesthetics.

  • The uncanny, early-internet strangeness of a forgotten digital world.

…Then you belong here.

data.short_description: You’re Here Again is a weirdcore fast-paced movement shooter, exploring the liminal space between the end of life and whatever comes after. Experience the slow deconstruction of your existence as you utilise a wide range of weapons to kill the strange creatures inhabiting this strange new realm.

English*, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Maori
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (1903 or newer)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.5 GHz (Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-410
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11-compatible GPU with 1 GB VRAM (GeForce GTX 460 / Radeon HD 5770 / Intel HD 4000)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Not required
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: None

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS+, SteamOS+
  • Processor: x86_64 (64-bit) CPU only
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+ and/or Vulkan 1.0+ capable GPU with 1 GB VRAM (GeForce GTX 460 / Radeon HD 5770 / Intel HD 4000)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Not required
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: None
